### Bio:

I am a master’s student in UCLA’s Data Science in Health program with a background in molecular, cellular, and developmental biology. My research interests lie at the intersection of genomics, epigenetics, and data science, with a current focus on DNA methylation and biological aging in psychiatric and brain-related disorders. I am especially interested in using interpretable computational methods to better understand human disease. Outside of research, I enjoy language learning, good food, and making complex scientific ideas easier to communicate.
